name: BOLT W16

specs.notes: The track-only Bolide as built (2024-25, 40 cars): the 8.0 W16 quad-turbo tuned for 98-octane pump fuel, 1,600 PS (1,578 hp) and 1,600 Nm from 2,250 rpm, 1,450 kg dry (Bugatti; Wikipedia; motor1). The 2020 concept made 1,850 PS on 110-octane race fuel at 1,240 kg and claimed over 500 km/h (simulated). No top speed is published for the production car: the 7-speed is spread as the Chiron's (420 km/h). The power peak's rpm (7,000, the concept's), weight distribution, drag and downforce are estimates (the track chassis' aero).

garage.blurb: Bugatti's W16 in a track-only carbon shell: 1,600 horsepower for 1,450 kg, racing wings and X-shaped lights. Not road legal anywhere, which is why it's here.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit: its rectangular wheel with a screen (cut out by material in a box, its column left in), the eye set by hand; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.

source.license: CGTrader Royalty Free License (seller CGI-FORGE, best match)

limitations: Top speed, the gear ratios, the power peak's rpm, weight distribution and aero are estimates.
Provenance: the model's materials are CSR Racing 2 assets ('CSR2_'): a game rip sold on CGTrader; fine among friends, replace before any public release.
Branding in its textures (W16.4 lettering, the EB logo, Michelin tyres) is left in.
